target: Native publisher main-image to canonical catalog item/domain association; not independently proven physical SKU identity
family_rule: Canonical eligible grocery listings grouped by normalized name+brand, plus same canonical brand and identical numeric-token signature with character 3-5gram cosine >=0.96; components are held within one split. Family links express input similarity, not physical-product truth.
family_normalization: NFKD accent removal; lowercase; non-alphanumeric to spaces; whitespace normalization. 365-brand aliases normalized to 365; other brands preserved. Leading Amazon Brand and title brand phrase removed for near-family comparison only.
selection: Forced inspected IDs and their family components reserved for development. Hash-sort remaining components; fill development then test query union then independent-family NIL distractors. Sort within component by independent item hash; unselected component members remain reserved to the same split. No image/model/OCR outcome affects selection.
image_rule: Canonical native main_image_id only; at least two globally item-exclusive image IDs required in source record and native main must be one. No substitutions or replacement items after fetch failure.

downloads.failure: Preserve row with failure, no replacement; metrics include all frozen queries.

ocr.text_merge: ordered unique nonempty normalized lines, psm11 then psm6

lexical.char_tfidf: char_wb 3-5 grams, sublinear TF, catalog fitted
lexical.closed: top1 with deterministic catalog-id tie break; empty evidence abstains
lexical.nil: No probability claim. Fixed score >=0.30 and top1-top2 margin >=0.03; sensitivity grid stored without selecting using test truth.

splink.supervision: No match labels read; u from all available cross-pairs/random sample, m by EM; fixed synthetic pair prior 1/catalog-size for closed and 0.8/catalog-size for designed NIL
splink.diagnostics: Save missingness, level counts, parameters, EM logs/failures and ranking ties; never silently replace an unfitted level or claim calibration.
splink.optional_comparison_support: Include quantity/model comparison only when at least10 nonmissing records on each side; input-only rule.
splink.tie_break: Frozen lexical score within exactly equal posterior values, followed by opaque catalog ID. Posterior threshold/margin values unchanged.
splink.diagnostic_development_predecessor: Initial blocked two-session EM retained in results/diagnostic-blocked-em-*; not selected using outcome labels. Replaced because probability sums were not normalized and iteration cap was reached.
splink.fit_validity: Single fixed200 cap, last parameter delta <=1e-4, all used m/u strictly positive finite with sums within1e-6 of1. Invalid fits retain diagnostics/model and emit fit_valid=false failure rows, which cannot count as successful NIL decisions.
splink.prior_sensitivity_mode: Posterior odds reweighted to feasible overlap_fraction/catalog_size, fitted likelihood ratios held fixed; no EM refit. Save each query, numeric prior, score and decisions at .8/.9/.95/.99. Primary fit/threshold unchanged.

clip.candidate_universe: all same catalog text rows; no catalog images
clip.nil: fixed cosine>=0.25 and margin>=0.02; report sensitivity without test tuning

outcome_policy: Freeze this file, sampling manifest, source hashes, feature and score policies before opening test outcome metrics. Development may inform a later explicitly versioned spending gate; all test methods use the same frozen records. Store predictions before evaluation.
uncertainty: Report query counts and family counts; family-cluster bootstrap for method differences when paired outcomes are available. Do not treat NIL and closed views as independent datasets.
input_duplicate_audit: SHA256 and decoded pixel hashes plus pHash<=4 flags after input download. Do not replace/drop sampled queries; report full denominator plus flagged/clean strata, and no cross-split exact duplicate contamination claim unless checked.
extraction_failure_handling: Missing row or whitespace-only extracted evidence always abstains; no opaque-ID closed top1 fallback.
decision_status_policy: Every row linked/nil/review/failed. Closed valid evidence =>linked; NIL valid evidence score<fixed threshold =>nil; score>=threshold with insufficient fixed margin=>review; otherwise linked. Failed/missing/decode/empty OCR or invalid fit=>failed. Successful empty/all-null extraction=>review. Review and failed are never correct NIL or automatic decisions.
